notes.title: Trident's Tale - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Dear Pirates

Version 1.0.1 is out now on Steam.,
Restart your Steam client in order to fetch the update.

------ Changelog ------
[list]
[*] Fixed and polishing for some cutscenes
[*] Fixed some incorrect Audio Behaviors 
[*] Small fixes for naval exploration
[*] Motion Blur post process fixes
[*] Improvement some fps during turntable camera
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announced | Out on May 22nd
notes.notes:
[b]All hands on deck, me hearties![/b]

We’re thrilled to finally announce that Trident’s Tale sets sail on [b]May 22nd[/b], launching across all platforms — including Steam!

To mark the occasion, we’ve prepared a[b] brand-new gameplay trailer[/b]. Dive in and get a fresh look at the adventure that awaits.

[previewyoutube=row2ihKRfws;full][/previewyoutube]

We can’t wait to see you all on Hoctal — the journey begins soon!
